architecture: OpenVision 2 ViT-L/14-224 (CVPR 2026, caption-only generative pretrained vision encoder, ~304M params)
feature: official OpenVision 2 pooled output (average pooling + final LayerNorm, 1024D)
preprocessing: official caption_example.py: shortest-edge bilinear resize to 224, center crop 224x224, ImageNet mean/std
selection_protocol: per-sample L2 normalization, train-only 5-fold C selection, LinearSVC refit on 434 train images, one validation evaluation
notes: CVPR 2026 generative pretrained vision encoder (arXiv:2509.01644, OpenVision 2). Loaded via official patched open_clip in .venv-lowformer; downstream LinearSVC runs in main .conda-env (scikit-learn 1.9.1).
